user.title: Configure OpenEVT
user.description:
The OpenEVT addon was not detected in Home Assistant Supervisor.

Enter the inverter endpoint URL(s) manually. For multiple inverters, separate values with semicolons (`;`).

If you have the OpenEVT addon installed, ensure it is running and you are using Home Assistant OS or Home Assistant Container.

data_description.url: HTTP URL to the /inverter endpoint. The default format is http://<addon-hostname>:9090/inverter (e.g. http://openevt:9090/inverter). For multiple inverters, separate with semicolons.
